items.name: Oat milk
items.description: Made from oats and water. It is creamy and a little sweet. Oats are a cereal, so this milk has gluten in it.

items.name: Almond milk
items.description: Made from almonds and water. It is thin and tastes a little nutty. Almonds are tree nuts.

items.name: Soya milk
items.description: Made from soya beans. It makes good foam. Some customers ask for soy, which is the same thing.

items.name: Coconut milk
items.description: Made from coconut and water. A coconut is not a tree nut, so this milk has none of the 14 allergens.

items.name: Skimmed milk
items.description: Cow's milk with nearly all the fat taken out. The cap is red. Some customers call it skinny milk.

items.name: Semi-skimmed milk
items.description: Cow's milk with some of the fat taken out. The cap is green. Most cafes use this milk.

items.name: Whole milk
items.description: Cow's milk with all the fat still in it. The cap is blue. It makes thick, creamy foam.

orders.text: a hot chocolate with whole milk
a flat white with skimmed milk
